definitions.explanation: To clean clothes, linens, or other fabric items, typically using water and detergent.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{洗濯|せんたく}する。
この{服|ふく}は{手|て}で{洗濯|せんたく}してください。
examples.english: Please wash these clothes by hand.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}で{洗濯|せんたく}ができなかった。
examples.english: I couldn't do laundry because of the rain.

notes:
{洗濯|せんたく}する means to wash clothes or do laundry. One of the most common household verbs in Japanese.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pattern: Xを{洗濯|せんたく}する

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {洗濯|せんたく}をする: to do laundry
- {洗濯|せんたく}{物|もの}を{干|ほ}す: to hang laundry to dry
- {洗濯|せんたく}{物|もの}を{取|と}り{込|こ}む: to bring in the laundry
- {手|て}{洗|あら}いで{洗濯|せんたく}する: to hand-wash

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {洗濯|せんたく}{機|き}: washing machine
- {洗濯|せんたく}{物|もの}: laundry, clothes to wash
- {洗濯|せんたく}{洗剤|せんざい}: laundry detergent
- コインランドリー: laundromat

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, hanging laundry outside to dry ({外干|そとぼ}し) is still very common. Many people check the {洗濯|せんたく}{指数|しすう} (laundry drying index) in weather forecasts.
